content.text: Tainted user input `param` flows unsanitized into `fileName`, which is passed to `open()` — a classic path traversal / path injection sink. No sanitization (e.g., path normalization or whitelist check) is applied before use.

input.justification: User-controlled input from request.args.get("BenchmarkTest00665") flows through a dictionary (map59129) without any sanitization into variable `bar`, which is directly concatenated into `fileName = f'{helpers.utils.TESTFILES_DIR}/{bar}'` and passed to `open(fileName, 'rb')`. There is no validation, normalization, or whitelist check on the path component, allowing path traversal (e.g., using '../' sequences) to read arbitrary files outside the intended TESTFILES_DIR. This matches the classic OWASP Benchmark path-traversal pattern and is a genuine path injection vulnerability.
